labels.environment: Every node is a dkv-server process on the machine below, with its data on ext4; the load generator runs on the same machine. 16 shards (and the meta group).
labels.title: fsync
labels.what: Three nodes, RF 3, writes only. storage.sync never skips every fsync of the Raft log: it shows what fsync costs, and loses acknowledged writes on power loss.
